title: Hand 4: transfer of the fixed position and boundary spelling mixture
statement: Apply the fixed M-005 mixture to hand 4: glyph-trigram spelling, position-conditioned and preceding-edge-conditioned spelling, position vocabulary, page-local exact or one-glyph copying, and a prefix-core-suffix template. Compare predictive cost with bag and glyph spelling baselines; the mixture tests predictive fit and does not identify the historical production process. Layout positions and previous word are supplied, including across line breaks within a page. On 757 practice words, the fixed M-005 mixture scores 12.2409 bits per word, versus 12.4158 for M-001 refitted to the same hand and pages. This is exploratory and the sample is small.
source: M-005 fixed configuration, also applied to hands 1 and 3; trusted component definitions in vs/models.py.
